We camped here for two nights with the kids and it was perfect. The sites are big and shady, the bathrooms were clean, and there is a creek right behind the tents where the kids caught poles all afternoon. The only downside is that the nearest store is 20 minutes away, so bring everything you need. We will definitely be back next summer.

I never thought I would be the kind of person who gets up at 5 in the morning to run. In fact, for most of my life I avoided exercise like it was homework, but last winter my doctor told me my blood pressure was too high, and something in me just decided enough. So I bought a cheap pair of running shoes and went out the next morning in the dark. I made it exactly two blocks before I had to stop and hold onto a lamp post, but I went back the next day, and the next. Now, 10 months later, I can run 5 kilometers without stopping, and more importantly I actually look forward to it, the quiet streets, the sunrise, the feeling that the day belongs to me.

Estimate for the interior job at the Kims, living room, hallway, and two bedrooms, about 900 square feet of wall, so two coats is roughly 10 gallons, because the walls are textured and drink the paint, plus a gallon of primer for the patch spots. Labor is three days with two people, so call it $2,400 for labor and $400 for materials. Tell them we can start the second week of November, and they need to move the furniture to the middle of the rooms the day before. Oh, and ask if they want the trim done in white or off-white.
An anniversary present for the in-laws.
